label: Musical instruments
description: Named musical instruments, from orchestral and regional acoustic instruments to electronic performance gear.
notes: Instrument names include articles or natural plurals so every value follows playing; object.furniture owns ordinary furnishings rather than instruments. Family chips follow the visible playing form, with electric strings and electronic keyboards also tagged electronic. Origin chips indicate broad musical traditions, not where a player must be or their descent, and widely shared forms may also be global. Oceania is left untagged rather than assigned an unrelated origin. Brand names are replaced by generic types, including tonewheel organ and handpan.
